trust_decision.summary: The attacker-controlled Referer header is trusted as a safe http(s) link: it is stored once per session without validation in MY_Controller::setReferrer, copied into orders at checkout, and rendered raw as an href and as text in the admin orders view.

landing_point.why: The advisory summary names MY_Controller.php setReferrer; the raw $_SERVER['HTTP_REFERER'] assignment is there.

fix_sites.entry_point: Any public storefront HTTP request (MY_Controller constructor calls setReferrer at line 15) whose session has no referrer yet; the value is persisted by POST /checkout
fix_sites.module_kind: core base controller (input capture into session)

fix_sites.entry_point: Admin HTTP route /admin/orders (authenticated admin view of stored orders)

O2_out_of_scope_site.where: Both published sites are on the direct path (capture, then the orders view). No second implementation, wrapper or serializer was changed.

O3_reason_to_dismiss: The admin dashboard chart prints clean_referrer (a derived 'domain only' value) inside a JS string, not an href. A solver can argue it is a different column, a different view (dashboard, not orders) and a 'host-only' value that the scheme check already makes safe.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Legitimate http(s) referrers must still be stored and shown as clickable links in admin orders. The 'Direct' sentinel must keep its 'Direct traffic' branch. The dashboard 'orders by referrer' chart groups by clean_referrer host. An over-broad fix (dropping all referrers, or storing only the host) breaks the link display and the grouping.

O6_input_shapes: non-http(s) scheme such as javascript:/data: (replaced by 'Direct')
scheme-less or relative value with no parse_url scheme (replaced by 'Direct')
HTML/attribute metacharacters in an http(s) URL (escaped at output with htmlspecialchars ENT_QUOTES)

O7_producer.where: application/helpers/cleanreferral_helper.php:12-19 (cleanReferral derives clean_referrer and returns the raw URL unchanged when no host parses); called at application/controllers/Checkout.php:31

O8_uncovered_routes.route: Stored clean_referrer, derived from the same session referrer, is echoed unescaped into an inline JS string literal on the admin dashboard chart
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Different column and view (dashboard chart, not order details), and the value is 'just a domain' after cleanReferral
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: Different module and view from the landing point (core/ to modules/admin/views/home/); reached through helpers/cleanreferral_helper.php:14-16 and models/Home_admin_model.php:59

O8_uncovered_routes.route: The same referrer and clean_referrer are written to vendors_orders for vendor products, a second store of the same value
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Vendor orders are a neighbouring feature, and no vendor view was found rendering referrer, so it is storage only

O8b_injection_room.sibling: A vendor-panel orders view rendering vendors_orders.referrer as a link, like admin orders.php:118
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The vendor module already selects vendors_orders.* including referrer, and the vendor orders page is natural to model on the admin orders page.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: The chart drilldown linking to the full referrer URL instead of the clean name
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: A maintainer adding click-through from the 'orders by referrer' chart would plausibly use the stored referrer.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: A 'back' redirect after login or cart actions using $this->agent->referrer()
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: A CodeIgniter idiom; the framework helper returns the raw Referer with only trim().

O9_family: Stored URI/markup injection from an untrusted Referer header (filed as CWE-601 open redirect; the mechanism is an unvalidated href scheme plus missing output encoding)

O10_build.toolchain: PHP with CodeIgniter 3 + HMVC (MX_Controller), bundled under system/; no composer manifest checked
O10_build.project_tests: None found: no tests/ or application/tests/ PHP files at the pinned commit

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Escape the referrer with htmlspecialchars in orders.php only (still allows a javascript: href), or validate in setReferrer only and leave the dashboard JS-string sink for clean_referrer unencoded.

out_of_scope_notes: Other order fields (city, address, notes) are echoed unescaped in the same admin orders view, application/modules/admin/views/ecommerce/orders.php:100-112; this is a separate stored-XSS concern, not pursued.

Pre-existing sessions keep their stored referrer, because setReferrer only runs when the session value is null (application/core/MY_Controller.php:150); a fix at capture does not clean already-stored order rows.
unverified: Repository size in MB was not measured (it includes bundled assets such as elFinder), so tiny_repo/giant_repo were not assessed.

Not verified whether PHP parse_url returns a host containing quote characters for http(s) URLs; that decides whether clean_referrer can still break out of the JS string at home.php:303 after the published fix.
Not checked whether any vendor-module view renders vendors_orders.referrer (a grep for 'referrer' found none).
The published-fix advisory text was not available, only the commit message; the latest release is 'none', so present_in_latest is unknown.
